crossRefs.note: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep…
Ah, the uproar of many peoples, who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations, that rush like the…
The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be…
“Who is this who rises up like the Nile, whose waters toss themselves like the rivers?
Egypt rises up like the Nile, and his waters toss themselves like the rivers. He says, ‘I will rise up. I will cover…
For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your…
The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by…
He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.
Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into…
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;

translations.web: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
translations.bsb: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
translations.kjv: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
translations.asv: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.
